rows: Right. The job is simple: do the technique properly and get everybody home.
Brawling is fine, as long as nobody gets hurt for the sake of it.
Risk, to me, is a shift that goes wrong. I have seen it. Do not make me see it again.
Taking it slow is fine, as long as it is safe. I have never once regretted taking my time.
The people paid, so we give them a decent shift. That is all.
I do the job properly, every time.
I have done this long enough to know what the job needs. I am still doing it.
Check the stance is safe. Nothing clever, just reliable.

Stalling is a shirker's trick. Not what I do.

Among the best, you say. Show me the work. I will believe it when I see you turn up every day.

On the mat, we go slowly and check each other. Simple.
